title: Learn About Water-Saving Irrigation
description: Review locally appropriate ways to reduce avoidable water use and discuss suitability with an agricultural adviser.

title: Explore Composting
description: Learn how suitable organic materials can be composted safely for use on the farm.

title: Record Soil-Health Observations
description: Record basic observations about the field and identify questions to discuss with a local agricultural expert.

title: Learn About Crop Diversity
description: Explore crop rotation or diversification options that may suit the local farm and season.

title: Share a Sustainable Farming Learning
description: Share one useful learning point with a peer or community group, without disclosing private farm information.
